definitions.gloss: at full speed; headlong; as fast as possible
definitions.explanation: Running or moving as quickly as possible without looking back, typically fleeing from something or rushing toward something.

examples.japanese: {一目散|いちもくさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: I run away at full speed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一目散|いちもくさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}→飼い主：15281_kainushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: The dog ran at full speed to its owner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{終業|しゅうぎょう}→終業：18204_shuugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ベル→ベル：01379_beru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一目散|いちもくさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: As soon as the closing bell rang, I rushed home at full speed.

notes:
{一目散|いちもくさん} emphasizes running without hesitation or looking around.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一目散|いちもくさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧: to flee at full speed
- {一目散|いちもくさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run at full speed
- {一目散|いちもくさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}け{出|だ}す→駆け出す：15597_kakedasu⟧: to dash off at full speed

ETYMOLOGY:
{一目|いちもく} means "one look" and {散|さん} means "scatter" - the idea is running so fast you don't even take a single look back.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脱兎|だっと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ごとく: like a fleeing rabbit
